title: WTTE-RNN: Weibull Time To Event Recurrent Neural Network
source: Chalmers University of Technology / University of Gothenburg
summary: This thesis proposes WTTE-RNN, a novel model for sequential prediction of time-to-event using Weibull distributions parameterized by recurrent neural networks. The framework handles continuous/discrete time, right censoring, recurrent events, and time-varying covariates common in applications like customer churn and failure prediction. The model is evaluated on simulated data and the CMAPSS jet engine dataset, demonstrating advantages over naive baseline methods.
